messages:
hana_billing: Heads-up: customer Solara Inc's wire for INV-3031 ($9,750) arrived but intermediary bank deducted unexpected fees, netting us $9,210. They sent Swift MT103 referencing our IBAN. Bank returned adjustment code 'INTFEE'. Need guidance on whether to bill back the shortfall or absorb it. @devon_treasury

devon_treasury: Can you attach the MT103 (or copy the trace info)? Intermediary fees vary by routing. If the originator chose OUR/OUR vs SHA/OUR, that decides who pays.

hana_billing: Pasted trace: "MT103: orderingCustomer=Solara Inc; charges=SHA; interveningAgent=DEUTDEFF; amount=9750 EUR; chargesApplied=540 EUR; net=9210 EUR"

csm_leah: Customer says their AP selected 'share fees' (SHA) but they didn't expect the large intermediary cut. They're willing to top up if we request but want clear instructions.

devon_treasury: SHA means fees are split; unfortunately the intermediary took 540 EUR. Two options: 1) Request customer to initiate a remediation refund/top-up for 540 EUR referencing MT103 UETR, 2) We can issue an invoice for the shortfall and email them to pay via card/ACH/wire. Remediation via bank can be slow. Which is faster for them?
hana_billing: Customer wants to pay quickly. They asked if we can mark invoice as partially paid and invoice the remainder.
cfo_emma: For <$10k shortfalls we usually accept a PO or email consent to bill remaining via card/ACH and mark paid on settlement. Confirm written approval from AP to charge the shortfall.

payments-bot: Logged wire: WIRE-1950012345, remittance attached: MT103. Net credited: 9210 EUR. Suggested actions: request top-up using original UETR or send new invoice for 540 EUR.

hana_billing: Drafting email to AP: "We received your wire but intermediary fees resulted in a 540 EUR shortfall. To complete settlement please either (A) initiate a top-up referencing UETR <uetr-code> to your bank so it tags the original payment, or (B) pay the attached one-line invoice (INV-3031-ADJ) for 540 EUR via this secure link. Please advise which you prefer."

csm_leah: I'll call them after sending the email. They prefer option B for speed.
devon_treasury: If they pick B, accept card or ACH and then reconcile the MT103 with the invoice on our side. Mark the original wire as 'partially received' and allocate once adjustment posts.
hana_billing: Customer chose option B and paid 540 EUR via card link. Payments-bot, confirm capture and reconcile.
payments-bot: Card capture successful for 540 EUR. Payment record updated: WIRE-1950012345 reconciled with INV-3031. Closing thread.
